levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد

notes: «وَ جَمَاعَةُ مَشَايِخِي» is a collective co-transmitter with the first name: unnamed, in the same level.
The Imam is written inside the chain after «عن» (owner ruling 2), so he stays a narrator; «قال سمعته يقول» is the same saying.
The leading «1» is a report number and is not read.
